# GameRevolution

> > GameRevolution is a comprehensive gaming media hub covering news, reviews, guides, and platform-specific content for PC, PlayStation, Nintendo, and Xbox.

Founded in 1996, GameRevolution provides expert gaming journalism, product reviews, and walkthroughs for millions of gamers. The site aggregates breaking gaming industry news, platform archives, and detailed guides across all major gaming ecosystems.

## Key Topics

- Gaming News
- Game Reviews
- Video Game Guides
- Fortnite
- Platform Archives (PC, PlayStation, Nintendo, Xbox)
- Gaming Gear & Tech Reviews
- Industry Updates
- Game Database
- Streamer Coverage
- Entertainment Crossovers
- Product Reviews
- Gaming Culture
- Collaborations

## Core Gaming Hub

- [GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com): GameRevolution homepage for gaming news, reviews, and guides
- [News - GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com/news): Latest gaming industry news and stories
- [Games - GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com/games): Game database and catalog with Titanfall 3 and upcoming releases

## Platform Archives

- [PC Archives - GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com/platform/pc): PC gaming platform archive with Fortnite and League of Legends
- [PlayStation Archives - GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com/platform/playstation): PlayStation gaming platform archive with reviews and guides
- [Xbox Archives - GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com/platform/xbox): Xbox platform archive with guides and gaming news
- [Nintendo Archives - GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com/platform/nintendo): Nintendo platform archive with news, guides, and rumors

## Reviews & Guides

- [Reviews - GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com/review): Gaming gear and tech peripheral reviews
- [GameRevolution - Product Reviews](https://www.gamerevolution.com/reviews): Expert product reviews for gaming gear and tech since 1996
- [Guides - GameRevolution](https://www.gamerevolution.com/guides): Video game guides including Monopoly Go tips and walkthroughs
